## 🇺🇦 Ukraine – Russia War

- 🕊️ **Peace talks stalled in Geneva** — territory and security guarantees remain the two core sticking points; Russia demands all of Donbas, Ukraine refuses withdrawal *(Reuters / Wikipedia)*
- 🇪🇺 UK, France & Germany issued joint statement June 7 backing direct dialogue; Kremlin declared EU conditions "completely unacceptable" on June 11 *(CNN / Reuters)*
- 🎯 US had targeted a **June 2026 peace deal deadline** — passed without breakthrough *(CNN)*
- 🛸 Ukraine continues deep-strike drone operations against Russian oil infrastructure *(WION)*
- ⚔️ Russia intensifying front-line assaults while talks proceed *(WION)*

## 🇮🇷 Iran Conflict & Aftermath

- 🕊️ **Ceasefire MOU signed June 17** — US, Israel & Iran agreed to end hostilities within 60 days *(Britannica / Al Jazeera)*
- 💥 War ran **Feb 28 – June 17, 2026**: US & Israel vs. Iran + allies; Supreme Leader Khamenei killed in opening strikes *(Wikipedia / Britannica)*
- 🚢 Strait of Hormuz shut during conflict; "line of communication" oversight mechanism now being established *(Al Jazeera)*
- 🤝 VP Vance traveling to Switzerland for follow-up talks; Qatar & Pakistan mediating; described as "positive and constructive" *(Al Jazeera / CNN)*
- 💔 Human toll: thousands dead in Iran & Lebanon, dozens in Israel & Gulf states, millions displaced *(Britannica)*
